key_insight: The paper reframes inverse problems around exploiting intrinsic mathematical or physical structure, rather than relying only on iterative objective minimization.
engineering_relevance: This could make inverse solvers faster, more interpretable, and better suited for decoupling multi-parameter estimation in computational science applications.
method: Defines Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI) as a new paradigm alongside Optimization-Driven Inversion (ODI).
Splits SDI into Mathematical Structure-Driven Inversion (MSDI) and Physical Structure-Driven Inversion (PSDI).
Gives representative methods: MSDPII via spectral-domain pseudo-inverse construction, and PSDWII/PSDBP via virtual-source projection and structural projections for neural networks.
evidence_signal: The abstract is conceptual and methodological; it does not report numerical experiments, datasets, or quantitative evaluation results.
watch_item: The framework’s practicality likely depends on whether the needed mathematical or physical structure can be identified reliably for a given inverse problem.
paper_title: Structure-Driven Inversion: A New Paradigm for Solving Inverse Problems
